articles.title: A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
articles.snippet: Users paid nearly $6 million in a day to create and trade tokens through Pons, more than they paid to use Pump or Hyperliquid, and even more than they paid to use Robinhood Chain itself.

articles.title: What Is Pons? The Robinhood Chain Meme Coin Factory Token Up 18,000% Since July
articles.snippet: PONS, the token behind Robinhood Chain's biggest meme coin factory, flipped CASHCAT to become the chain's largest cryptocurrency by market cap—and its chart looks like a hockey stick.

articles.title: Crypto Wallets Can ‘Directly Compete With Neobanks'
articles.snippet: Bitget Wallet CMO Jamie Elkaleh tells Decrypt how the platform is evolving from a crypto wallet to a everyday finance app that seamlessly integrates crypto with TradFi, building on its vision of "Crypto for Everyone." - (Sponsored post by Bitget Wallet)
